title: Inspirations
subtitle: An inspiration is an idea to keep: a link, a photo, a note. It is not a validated recipe yet. It becomes a draft, then a recipe when you validate it.
empty: No inspiration yet. Write down an idea, paste a link or add a photo.
open-link: Open the link in a new tab
delete-keeps-recipe: The recipe created from this inspiration is kept.

field.title: Title
field.url-invalid: The address must start with http:// or https://
field.tags-hint: Type a tag, then press Enter.

image.title: Image
image.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB at most.
image.wrong-type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
image.too-large: The image is larger than 10 MB.

draft.title: Recipe draft
draft.start-help: When you like the idea, turn it into a draft to write the recipe: name, servings, ingredients and steps.
draft.help: Fill in the draft at your own pace. It becomes a recipe only when you validate it.
draft.name: Recipe name
draft.servings-hint: Required: the application uses it to scale the recipe to the number of guests.
draft.ingredients-hint: One ingredient per line, with its quantity and unit.
draft.check-quantities: Before you validate, check every quantity, every unit and the number of servings yourself. The application then computes portions and shopping from these values.
draft.missing: To validate, the draft still needs:

structure.title: AI assistant (optional)
structure.help: The assistant can suggest a draft from your note or your link. Nothing changes here: you accept or reject its proposal on the assistant page.
structure.done: A draft proposal is waiting for you on the assistant page. Read it, then accept or reject it.

validated.text: This inspiration is now a recipe. To change it, open the recipe.
